legal.grievance.pending.defaultMessage: The grievance officer's name and email will be added here before launch.

legal.privacy.meta.description.defaultMessage: What TodayZ collects, why, who sees it, and how to use your rights under India's data protection law.

legal.privacy.s1.body.defaultMessage: From shops: name, shop name, mobile number, city and address, and the stock and sales data you add. From shoppers: mobile number, name, a location you choose to share, and your bookings.

legal.privacy.s2.body.defaultMessage: To run TodayZ: to show shops near you, to handle bookings, to give support and to keep the service safe. We ask for your consent where the law needs it.

legal.privacy.s3.body.defaultMessage: A shop sees the details of a shopper who books with it. Services that host TodayZ and send messages for us handle data on our behalf. Demand insights show shops grouped, anonymous search counts, never a shopper's name or number.

legal.privacy.s4.body.defaultMessage: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and you can withdraw your consent, by writing to the grievance officer below.

legal.terms_shoppers.meta.description.defaultMessage: The rules for using TodayZ to find and book items from shops.

legal.terms_shoppers.s1.body.defaultMessage: TodayZ helps you find items in shops near you and book them. Use it only for yourself, with true details, and do not misuse it.

legal.terms_shoppers.s2.body.defaultMessage: Stock and prices come from the shops and can change. A booking is between you and the shop; TodayZ connects the two of you.

legal.terms_shoppers.s3.body.defaultMessage: Read the refunds and credits page for what happens when a booking is cancelled.

legal.terms_shoppers.s4.body.defaultMessage: We may update these terms and will show the date of the latest version. Indian law applies.

legal.terms_shops.meta.description.defaultMessage: The rules for shops that list stock and take bookings on TodayZ.

legal.terms_shops.s1.body.defaultMessage: You can list the stock you really have and take bookings from people nearby. Keep your details and stock correct.

legal.terms_shops.s2.body.defaultMessage: You are responsible for the goods you sell and for the licences and taxes your shop needs. Do not list goods that the law does not allow you to sell.

legal.terms_shops.s3.body.defaultMessage: Look after the bookings you accept. A booking is between you and the shopper; TodayZ connects the two of you.

legal.terms_shops.s4.body.defaultMessage: TodayZ is free for shops for now. The pricing page always shows the current position.

legal.terms_shops.s5.body.defaultMessage: We may update these terms and will show the date of the latest version. We may pause a shop that breaks them. Indian law applies.

legal.refunds.meta.description.defaultMessage: What happens to a booking when it is cancelled, and how credits work.

legal.refunds.s1.body.defaultMessage: You can cancel a booking before the shop has handed over your items. Once items are handed over, the shop's own return policy applies.

legal.refunds.s2.body.defaultMessage: The rules for how long credits last and where they can be used are being finalised. They will be set out here before launch.

legal.refunds.s3.body.defaultMessage: If something went wrong with a booking, write to the grievance officer below.
